stories.title: Merz's CDU hits worst postwar state result, vows to stay and push reforms
new_facts: AfD scores 37%+ in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania; Weidel says Merz can no longer stay in office.
Actual results: CDU suffers historic defeat in Berlin and MVP elections, Die Linke gains in Berlin.
AfD takes first place in MVP; CDU posts worst state election result since 1949.
Merz vows to stay in office after CDU finishes behind far-right and far-left in eastern states.
Despite big gains, AfD has no viable path to form a state government in either Berlin or MVP.
CDU narrowly cleared 5% threshold in Berlin; Die Linke on course for victory there.
Exit polls show CDU with single-digit support in the Baltic coast region, trailing far-left in Berlin.
Merz scheduled a crisis meeting as voting began amid EU fears of another AfD victory.
stories.line: German Chancellor Merz's party suffered historic losses in two state elections, its worst postwar regional result, but Merz pledged to continue.
